critical_code_review_comments: PATTERN: All SQLAlchemy async lazy-loading issues follow the same root cause - db.refresh() and model_validate() on ORM objects with unloaded relationships. The fix pattern is: always use selectinload() before model_validate(). A full audit of all endpoints that call model_validate on models with relationships should be done.

SECURITY: Brute force detection (check_brute_force in auth_service.py) tracks IP:email combinations. The test IP (test runner) gets rate-limited due to multiple test logins before the 5-fail threshold is hit per email. Consider separate IP-based and email-based lockout thresholds.
The MFA test leaves super admin in MFA-disabled state as required. Recovery mechanism via DB script is documented.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of POST /api/super-admin/tenants 500: After db.commit(), SQLAlchemy expires all loaded ORM attributes. Calling db.refresh(tenant) only refreshes the tenant's own columns, not its relationships (settings). When TenantResponse.model_validate(tenant) then accesses tenant.settings, it triggers a lazy load which fails in async context (MissingGreenlet). Fix: replace db.refresh() with explicit SELECT + selectinload(Tenant.settings) to eagerly fetch the relationship.
